source_references.title: Public Disclosure Requirements for the First Financial Year Adopting RBC Regime, Annex 1 — Capital composition disclosure fields
source_references.section: Section 4, Capital adequacy, paragraphs (a)–(b), printed pages 4–5
source_references.text: The template separates PCA and risk capital amounts from capital base. Its capital-base table lists Unlimited Tier 1, Limited Tier 1 and Tier 2 capital.
source_references.provenance: Official-domain text surfaced by web search index; full PDF retrieval unavailable in this session.
source_references.redistribution: Short original paraphrase with attribution; no bulk source text redistributed. Source-specific reuse permission has not been verified; no open licence is asserted.
source_references.limitations: A disclosure template establishes fields, not capital eligibility, deductions, limits or calculation formulas. Numeric tier caps are omitted because operative rule 7 was not independently verified from primary text in this session.

source_references.title: Insurance (Valuation and Capital) Rules, L.N. 62 of 2024 — Capital adequacy thresholds
source_references.text: Subject to rule 5(2), an applicable insurer must maintain capital base at least equal to each of its prescribed capital amount, minimum capital amount and HK$20 million. Capital base follows Part 3; PCA follows Part 5.
source_references.provenance: Official-domain text surfaced by web search index; full PDF retrieval unavailable in this session.
source_references.redistribution: Short original paraphrase with attribution; no bulk source text redistributed. Source-specific reuse permission has not been verified; no open licence is asserted.
source_references.limitations: Historical baseline only; requires insurer applicability, valuation date, variations/relaxations and current official text. Does not establish a complete regulatory calculation.

source_references.title: Insurance (Valuation and Capital) Rules, L.N. 62 of 2024 — Minimum capital amount baseline
source_references.text: MCA is 50% of PCA unless the IA determines another amount through the variation or relaxation mechanism in rule 5(2).
source_references.provenance: Official-domain text surfaced by web search index; full PDF retrieval unavailable in this session.
source_references.redistribution: Short original paraphrase with attribution; no bulk source text redistributed. Source-specific reuse permission has not been verified; no open licence is asserted.
source_references.limitations: Do not apply the 50% baseline if an insurer-specific variation or relaxation applies.
